faqs.question: What Nothing Phone accessories should I buy first?
faqs.answer: Start with a compatible case, screen protection and a reliable charger or cable. Add audio or photography accessories according to your actual use.

faqs.question: Which charger is best for Nothing Phone?
faqs.answer: Use a reputable charger that supports the exact phone’s charging standard and required power. Confirm the manufacturer’s guidance and use a safe certified product.

faqs.question: Does Nothing Phone include a charger?
faqs.answer: Box contents vary by model and market. Confirm the exact seller listing before assuming an adapter is included.

faqs.question: Can I use a Samsung charger with Nothing Phone?
faqs.answer: A compatible USB-C charger can work, but charging speed depends on supported standards, power and cable quality. Avoid counterfeit adapters.

faqs.question: Which case fits Nothing Phone?
faqs.answer: Buy a case made for the exact model, because camera cut-outs, buttons, dimensions and wireless features can differ between generations.

faqs.question: Does Nothing Phone need a screen protector?
faqs.answer: A screen protector is optional but useful for reducing scratches. Choose one with accurate fit and do not mistake scratch protection for shatterproof protection.

faqs.question: Can I use wireless charging accessories?
faqs.answer: Compatibility varies by Nothing Phone model and accessory. Check the exact phone specification before buying a wireless charger or magnetic mount.

faqs.question: Are Nothing Ear earbuds compatible with Samsung phones?
faqs.answer: Nothing Ear products can generally pair with compatible Bluetooth phones, while advanced controls may require the companion app and supported software.

faqs.question: How do I identify fake Nothing accessories?
faqs.answer: Check packaging, seller reputation, serial information, build quality, charging behaviour, invoice and return terms. Avoid unusually cheap listings with no traceable warranty.

faqs.question: Do I need a special USB-C cable?
faqs.answer: Choose a quality cable rated for the phone’s charging needs and, if required, data or video use. USB-C connectors do not guarantee identical capabilities.

faqs.question: What accessories are useful for students?
faqs.answer: A protective case, screen protector, reliable charger, spare cable and power bank are usually more useful than decorative add-ons.

faqs.question: Should I buy official or third-party accessories?
faqs.answer: Either can work when specifications, safety, compatibility and warranty are clear. Reputable third-party accessories may offer value, but avoid untraceable products.
